mentions.name: Echovale
mentions.description: A focused, minimal-distraction RSS feed reader app. It supports feeds from sites without RSS or Atom, includes filters (e.g., removing YouTube Shorts from YT feeds), and reads X via Nitter, with a comfortable focused reading experience. Planned for App Store release as a serverless, local-first app with sync via iCloud.
mentions.problem: After years of trying many RSS readers, none fit all the author's requirements.
mentions.source_excerpt: Feed (RSS) reader. I've been using RSS readers for many years and have tried a lot of them, but I never found an app that fits all my requirements. It became easy enough to build my own version, so I did.
mentions.author: egornomic
